title: Join Us
subtitle: Graduate application materials are reviewed each semester.
intro: Email the following documents to Professor Hongjo Kim. Applicants will receive a reply by email after their materials have been reviewed.
docs: A personal statement explaining your motivation for applying
An academic transcript including your class rank
masters_text: Applicants are encouraged to apply for the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) first and to apply to the lab after securing GKS funding.
phd_text: Ph.D. applicants are also encouraged to apply to the lab after being selected for GKS.
program_text: As of September 2026, a Yonsei University support program for international students is available for the next two years. Ph.D. applicants without GKS funding may therefore be considered based on their qualifications.
letter_text: If a recommendation letter is needed during the application process, please email your CV, academic transcript, and personal statement.
courses: Artificial Intelligence for Civil and Environmental Engineering
